schedule.title: Morning briefing
schedule.prompt: Write the morning briefing for the biofuels desk: what moved in US biofuels markets and policy since the last business day, and what to watch today.

schedule.title: EIA ethanol story
schedule.prompt: Write the data-release story on the latest EIA weekly ethanol data: production and stocks, week over week and year over year, with a chart.

schedule.title: Policy explainer
schedule.prompt: Write an explainer on the most significant US federal or California biofuels policy action of the past two weeks (RFS, LCFS, 45Z or SAF): what changed, who it affects, and what happens next.

schedule.title: Morning briefing
schedule.prompt: Write the morning briefing for the crude oil desk: what moved in US crude supply data and policy recently, and what to watch today.

schedule.title: EIA crude story
schedule.prompt: Write the data-release story on the latest EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report: commercial crude stocks, Cushing, production and refinery utilization, week over week and year over year, with a chart.
